environment.tool: manual audit of the final tag source + live compiled binary; raw-socket client sending exact bytes, strict-token upstream peer logging verbatim request bytes and byte count

findings.description: Six builds compute rel=path.substr(alias_len) after an unanchored prefix match and hand the slice to an openat loop with no dot-dot component check, so a decoded path like /al../proc/self/cmdline escapes the alias root and is mechanically readable. Five builds normalize the decoded path before the slice and reject every dot-dot component with 403, closing the shape by construction. Live byte proof for /proc/self/* was not completed inside the turn budget and is marked not-proven.
findings.title: Alias-slice dot-dot escape stays open on 6 of 11 proxied builds (/al../ shape)

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
